decision: BLOCKED: production backend defects prevent end-to-end sign-off

local_fixes.result: WordPress 7.0 activates current WooCommerce; tracked local environment updated.
Bootstrap waits for init at priority -1, before WooCommerce loads active webhook callbacks; regression and OAuth with debug display enabled pass.
A real auto-draft follows confirmed-unpublished removal/no-op behavior without publication retries.

external_issues.finding: Production rejects the documented UNCONFIGURED source ingestion variant.
The production admin source creation form defaults to and submits that rejected variant; reproduced HTTP 400 in the browser.

Signed updates acknowledged around 20:34 applied at 20:54:57, restored a listing already synchronously withdrawn at 20:54:26, and left its original title. The accepted 20:38 deletion did not prevent restoration. QA withdrew it again at 20:56:35.
A native child variation update creates a duplicate standalone listing with the parent title/permalink and a different price.

live_checks.case: OAuth consent, denial, successful broker callback and same-source reconnect
live_checks.evidence: Real production client, granted test source, PKCE/broker exchange, HTTP 200 token exchange and 204 provider registration; denial preserved the existing connection.
Actual WooCommerce webhooks; bearer header present and HMAC matches the exact outgoing body; HTTP 204. Application of later updates/deletion fails separately (#2522).
Published simple, zero-price and virtual products materialized; draft omitted; descriptions intentionally excluded under existing issue #93.
106 published products submitted in batches of 100 and 6. Simulated a lost successful 202 response after real admission; retry body SHA-256 and idempotency-key SHA-256 match exactly.

Before cleanup 104 canonical test records were observed including baseline and variation fixtures; source IDs 20-24 from the admitted bulk run had not materialized. HTTP 202 is admission only. Do not interpret the local completed status as complete ingestion.

Profile and source default published; simple membership and virtual suppression confirmed. A price-only edit through the WooCommerce modal changed the production rate from EUR 495 to 695 minor units. Class rates 100/250/500 per item, seller-order free-shipping threshold EUR 10000, restricted fallback geography, pickup confirmation and mixed variation-class PARTIAL inputs with both variation codes were read back from production.
The worker retained pending PRODUCT_LISTING_NOT_FOUND work while admitted catalog records were unavailable. Profile and variable-product writes succeeded; cleanup stopped remaining work.
An explicit manual profile replacement survived connector uninstall unchanged; the connector cleared its owned default. QA subsequently retired the manual fixture through the admin API.
BHD paused all three hooks and showed the supported-currency error; restoring EUR resumed the same managed hooks.
Changed an owned endpoint and deleted the update webhook; the next bootstrap restored the endpoint and exactly three active hooks (IDs 1,4,3).
Subscriber receives 403; shop manager receives 200; invalid action nonce receives 403; stored token absent from page HTML and release ZIP.

live_checks.case: Release installation, deactivation, reactivation and uninstall
live_checks.evidence: Installed and activated the built ZIP. Owned-profile deactivation retired the profile and cleared its default; reactivation restored its identity without a fresh initial catalog run. Uninstall left no settings, managed hooks or pending connector actions.

live_checks.case: Public product page and provider handoff
live_checks.evidence: Production product page rendered, with history and provider link. Product and REST URLs used reserved public fixtures because production blocks loopback URLs; a publicly reachable real storefront/checkout was not tested.

cleanup.retention_reason: Production rejects physical deletion of a used source/party with protected listing, raw-ingestion and partnership history. Source renamed QA RETIRED WooCommerce 20261026 and all ingestion configurations removed. Listings are withdrawn, not physically erased.
cleanup.final_verification: Zero active test listings in repeated administrator reads after 20:56:35; monitor results recorded below.

history_timeline.event: Delayed price change and RESTORED to IN_STOCK

limits: No claim of 100% compatibility or production readiness. Backend blockers require fixes and another real flow run.
The full supported WordPress/WooCommerce/PHP version matrix was not run locally.
Reused local Action Scheduler storage required its normal migration before group CLI execution.
Only QA-owned production records were mutated; other repositories were inspected and received issues, not code changes.
